searched.title: Bambu Lab X2D Spec Sheet
searched.note: All 3 pages read in full (pdftotext -layout per page, checked against a render of each page), footnotes 1-3 on p.3 included. No package size, package weight or gross weight on the sheet; no layer height, auto-levelling, nozzle or BirdsEye camera, hotend type, rated power, current, standby power, Bluetooth or unsupported-filament row.

notes: Starter kit: the printer specifications are the X2D's (this page carries the X2D spec table and links the X2D spec sheet). Physical size and net weight are the printer's alone (test_condition says so); the whole kit's size, net weight, package and gross weight are not published (shipment.gross_weight and package.* are not_published: the store table's "Gross Weight: X2D 20.2 kg, X2D AMS Combo 22.2kg" names the two printer versions, not this kit, and it is the US store table).

Dual-hotend keys are used instead of the generic ones: extrusion.main_/aux_extruder_gear and _motor carry the sheet's "Toolhead" and "Auxiliary Extruder" rows, and printing.filament_main_hotend / filament_aux_hotend / filament_aux_hotend_caution carry the three "Filament Supported" rows. extrusion.extruder_gear, extrusion.extruder_motor and printing.supported_filament are therefore neither specs nor not_published.

Left out on purpose (neither a spec nor not_published): connectivity.npu (only "with dedicated NPU" inside the Application Processor row), connectivity.interface (a USB port is named only inside the Storage row, the 6-pin ports only in FAQ 6), electrical.requirements (a group heading; footnote 2 is region evidence), printing.working_area (laser), electrical.battery / electrical.connector, part.material, carton.*, package.volume_m3 (owner-only, derived), identity.*, compat.statement, variant.note and manufacturer_terms.* (the SEO description's store warranty and return wording is store policy and is not recorded).

Package gap, not a data gap: for this page-builder page the package parses none of the three tables (content-block-19 "Specs", content-block-18 "What's in the box", the FAQ) and collects no document (the spec sheet is a downloadButton), and it reads no box items from the Product Features list. The deterministic payload holds only electrical.voltage (us_110v) and six not_found rows. Every store-table value was compared by hand with the sheet; the only disagreement of fact is "Support for PA/PET" in the main-hotend list (conflict on printing.filament_main_hotend).

Marketing numbers not recorded: "31 sensors", "20 kHz" PMSM sampling, "over 1,000,000 switch cycles", "roughly every three months" firmware updates, "up to 30%" shorter print time with high-flow hotends. Noise ("below 50 dB") is kept unverified.

Not recorded: the "Product Variation Notice" (some production batches have a silicone wiper near the nozzle-switching area, replaced by a software update) and the SEO meta description (store offers and policies).
